title: Meet M2 Lab: one job before one more subscription
hooks: Before your team buys another AI subscription, write down one job it needs to do.
A tool stack is not the same thing as a useful workflow.
Before adding another AI app, answer one boring question.
full_spoken_english: Before your team buys another AI subscription, write down one job it needs to do. Suppose customer questions arrive in three places. The job is getting each person a checked answer using the current policy. At M2 Lab, our Radar videos look at tools through tasks like this. Make a short checklist: use the supplied policy, show missing information, leave the answer editable, and wait before sending. Now try two options with the same fictional question. Put their drafts side by side with that checklist. Which answer can your colleague check and correct? What setup would the team have to maintain? Those questions belong in the comparison too. Keep the checklist when the tool names change. What is one requirement your next subscription would have to pass?
cta: Keep the checklist when the tool names change. What is one requirement your next subscription would have to pass?

fixture.input: Fictional policy: exchanges within 14 days with receipt. Question: can I exchange? Purchase date missing.
fixture.designed_output: Editable draft asks for purchase date and receipt; no send action.
fixture.check: Use supplied policy, flag missing date, retain editable draft, no automatic sending.

audio_plan: Natural recorded voice; no imitation. Quiet room; optional subtle licensed music only after voice intelligibility check. No sound needed to understand proof panels.
caption_plan: Editable sentence captions, maximum two short lines; keep proof labels clear. Captions paraphrase nothing that changes a fact. Final platform safe-zone check after edit.
